patthana18.3:1.1: hetuṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetu ceva na ahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:2.1: na hetuṃ sahetukañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na ahetuko ceva na na hetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:3.1: hetuṃ hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetu ceva na hetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:4.1: na hetuṃ hetusampayuttañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na hetuvippayutto ceva na na hetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:5.1: na hetuṃ na hetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
